background: Raiffeisen Bank International is the central institution of the Austrian Raiffeisen cooperative banks and a leading lender across Central and Eastern Europe, with a large and long-running exposure to Russia that it has been unable to fully exit.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the bank, A on average and the weakest at A-, one placed on a positive outlook on 2 Sep 2026. Capital is strong, with CET1 of 18.3% and leverage of 8.8% both in the top quarter of EU and Nordic banks. Liquidity is the softer side: LCR of 144% is below the peer median after falling 38 points since 30 Jun 2025, though NSFR of 155% is in the top quarter. The figures run to 30 Jun 2026.
